All other Apr-Sep 2027 items come from the youth department PDFs: ARKLAC Master Guides Calendar 2026-2027 (runs to Dec 2027 holidays) and ARKLA Adventurer Calendar 2026-2027 (ends May 2027).

Not counted (months or deadlines, not events): Adventurer and Master Guide investiture month (May 2027), Master Guide recruiting month (Jul 2027), club start (Aug 2027), Master Guide registration deadline (Aug 31, 2027), induction month (Sep-Oct 2027).
The Pathfinder page labels its calendar 2026-2027, but the link still opens the 2025-2026 Pathfinder calendar. Spring 2027 Pathfinder camporee, PBE and honors dates are therefore not published yet.
